statement: A current-run provenance boundary and a caller-facing artifact directory are different trust domains. Generate and read the authoritative result only in a fresh Action-owned directory outside the repository, then treat the documented out-dir strictly as an export sink. Preserving repeat-run compatibility requires testing a populated destination and caller-owned inputs without ever accepting them as current-run evidence. Any backup path used during export is itself repository-controlled: lstat every component, reject symlinks and non-directories, and clean the Action-owned temporary directory on both success and failure. Exercise the real runner through early failure, repeat success, newline-bearing outputs, and a symlinked backup component.
quarantineReason: This staging record accompanies the Action current-run provenance branch, whose eventual squash commit does not yet exist on Cejel origin/main. It must not anchor to its own branch.
moveCondition: After the Action provenance PR merges, identify its 40-character squash commit on Cejel origin/main and verify that its diff uses a fresh Action-owned output directory, multiline GitHub outputs, repeat-run export coverage, temporary-directory cleanup, and symlink rejection for backup components. Then copy this record into Alfred docs/orchestration/maeve-lesson-batches/ with the required cejel_ filename prefix and that origin/main commit anchor.
